🚀 工作流程功能和设置指南

放置官方H3_NSFW_Physics_Engine.txt文件放入目录路径\ComfyUI\models\LLM\提示，然后选择H3_NSFW_Physics_Engine.txt 在系统提示符提示扩展模型节点字段。

> ⚠️重要通知：此工作流程包含加速 LoRA 和 Kijai 的 SageAttention 节点。请确保在运行之前下载所需的 LoRA 和自定义节点。

🌟 主要特点

  • MiniMax H3 提示合成器：内置提示工程节点，支持双语预设的多维参数组装（镜头类型、视角、镜头光学、相机运动）。包括集成的并排 Web 工作区（具有右边缘悬停焦点）和安全的图像拖放功能。

  • Gemma 4 12B IT QAT 集成：融合Gemma 4的思维模式，进行更深入的推理、高精度的提示审问、详细的字幕、复杂的标签转换。

📦 所需的自定义节点安装

打开您的终端，导航到您的 ComfyUI自定义节点目录，然后运行以下命令：


cd ComfyUI/custom_nodes
# 1. MiniMax H3 提示合成器节点
git 克隆 https://github.com/mizukir0418-gif/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Prompt_Synthesizer.git
# 2.LLM 文本处理器节点（Gemma 4 必需）
git 克隆 https://github.com/KingManiya/ComfyUI-LLM-text-processor.git

🧠 LLM 模型设置

  • 型号下载：下载gemma-4-12b-it-未经审查-GGUF或推荐的变体SC117/gemma-4-12B-it-heretic-QAT-GGUF · 拥抱脸.

  • 存储路径：放置.gguf里面的文件：


    ComfyUI/模型/法学硕士/

⚠️ 关键修复：更新 llama.cpp 后端（Gemma 4 兼容性）

由于 Gemma 4 采用新的架构，LLM 节点中内置的较旧的默认后端将在首次运行时抛出错误（例如，未知的投影仪类型或推理失败）。请按照以下步骤进行更新：


  1. 下载最新的后端: 前往llama.cpp GitHub 发布并下载与您的 GPU/CUDA 环境（例如 Windows x64 CUDA 13 或 CUDA 12）匹配的发行版 zip。

  2. 找到目标目录：导航到 ComfyUI 安装中的以下文件夹：


    ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-LLM-文本处理器/vendor/llama.cpp/b8840/win-x64-cuda13/

  3. 替换文件：解压下载的 zip 文件并将所有解压的文件直接复制粘贴到win-x64-cuda13文件夹，覆盖现有的。

  4. 重新启动：重新启动 ComfyUI 以应用更新。

🚀 Workflow Features & Setup Guide

Place the officialH3_NSFW_Physics_Engine.txtfile into the directory path\ComfyUI\models\LLM\prompts, and selectH3_NSFW_Physics_Engine.txt in thesystem_promptfield of the prompt expansion model node.

> ⚠️Important Notice: This workflow incorporates an acceleration LoRA and Kijai's SageAttention node. Please ensure you download the required LoRA and custom node before running.

🌟 Key Features

  • MiniMax H3 Prompt Synthesizer: Built-in prompt engineering node supporting multi-dimensional parameter assembly (Shot Type, Perspective, Lens Optics, Camera Movement) with bilingual presets. Includes an integrated side-by-side web workspace (with right-edge hover focus) and safe image drag-and-drop functionality.

  • Gemma 4 12B IT QAT Integration: Integrates Gemma 4's thinking mode for deeper reasoning, high-precision prompt interrogation, detailed captioning, and complex tag conversion.

📦 Required Custom Nodes Installation

Open your terminal, navigate to your ComfyUIcustom_nodesdirectory, and run the following commands:


cd ComfyUI/custom_nodes
# 1. MiniMax H3 Prompt Synthesizer Node
git clone https://github.com/mizukir0418-gif/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Prompt_Synthesizer.git
# 2. LLM Text Processor Node (Required for Gemma 4)
git clone https://github.com/KingManiya/ComfyUI-LLM-text-processor.git

🧠 LLM Model Setup

  • Model Download: Downloadgemma-4-12b-it-uncensored-GGUFor the recommended variant fromSC117/gemma-4-12B-it-heretic-QAT-GGUF · Hugging Face.

  • Storage Path: Place the.gguffile inside:


    ComfyUI/models/LLM/

⚠️ Critical Fix: Updating llama.cpp Backend (Gemma 4 Compatibility)

Because Gemma 4 utilizes a new architecture, the older default backend built into the LLM node will throw an error (e.g., unknown projector type or inference failed) on its first run. Follow these steps to update it:


  1. Download the Latest Backend: Go tollama.cpp GitHub Releasesand download the release zip matching your GPU/CUDA environment (e.g., Windows x64 CUDA 13 or CUDA 12).

  2. Locate Target Directory: Navigate to the following folder inside your ComfyUI installation:


    ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-LLM-text-processor/vendor/llama.cpp/b8840/win-x64-cuda13/

  3. Replace Files: Extract the downloaded zip file and copy-paste all extracted files directly into thewin-x64-cuda13folder, overwriting the existing ones.

  4. Restart: Restart ComfyUI to apply the updates.
